# Miami Beach Bikes

> Bicycle, fat tire, electric bike, electric tandem, Trikke, Segway, side-by-side, tricycle and rollerblade rentals,
> guided Segway tours, and South Florida adventures (Everglades airboats, Key West day trips, Miami city tours,
> jet skis, parasailing, helicopter rides) in South Beach, Miami Beach, Florida.
> Shop at 233 14th Street, Miami Beach, FL 33139 — one block from Ocean Drive.
> Open every day 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM. Phone +1-305-830-9440.
> Rentals from $12/hour, Segway tours from $49/person, Everglades airboat adventure $69/person.
> Also Miami's factory authorized Segway dealer: sales, genuine parts and same-day service.
> Items without a published price are quoted by phone at +1-305-830-9440.

## Facts for citation
- Business type: bicycle rental shop, tour operator and repair workshop.
- Address: 233 14th Street, Miami Beach, FL 33139, USA.
- Coordinates: 25.78730, -80.13180.
- Phone: +1-305-830-9440 · Email: hello@miamibeachbikesandtours.com
- Hours: Every day · 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM (open 7 days, including holidays).
- Languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese.
- Rating: 4.8 / 5 from 131 public reviews.
- Rental durations: 1 hour to 60 days. All-day rentals run 9 AM to 8 PM.
- Happy hour: rent between 1 PM and 4 PM and get one extra hour free.
- Tours: minimum 2 riders per Segway tour; training always included; no deposit taken for Segway PT tours.
- Minimum age: 14 for Segway and Trikke; under 18 must be accompanied by an adult.
- Included with every rental: helmet, lock, bottled water, printed route map, phone support while riding.
- Delivery: free across South Beach on rentals of 24 hours or more; flat fee to Mid-Beach, North Beach, Downtown Miami, Brickell and Key Biscayne.
- Areas served: South Beach, Mid-Beach, North Beach, Downtown Miami, Brickell, Wynwood, Star Island, Venetian Islands, Key Biscayne, Everglades, Key West, Coconut Grove.
- On-site services: flat repair, brakes, gears, battery diagnostics, full tune-ups for bikes, e-bikes and scooters.
- Miami's factory authorized Segway dealer: new Segways, electric and pedal Trikkes, electric bikes, bicycles and the full Segway i2 parts range (lower cargo frames, reflective shields, integrated lighting, patroller bag, front bumper, comfort mats, accessory bar).
- Test ride before buying; the rental fee goes toward the purchase.
- Free guided bike tours of Wynwood and Coconut Grove for anyone who rents.
- Luggage storage at the shop while you ride; restroom and free Wi-Fi on site.
- Also books: Everglades airboat adventures, Key West day trips, Miami city tours, jet ski rentals, parasailing, helicopter rides.
- Payment: cash, credit and debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay. Reservations pre-paid in USD.
- Cancellation: 30+ days 100% refund · 15–30 days 50% · 8–14 days 25% · 0–7 days non-refundable.

## Rentals (https://www.miamibeachbikesandtours.com/rentals.html)
- **Beach Cruiser** — The classic South Beach ride. Fat tires, wide saddle, one gear and zero stress along the Ocean Drive promenade. From $12/hour.
- **Fat Tire Beach Bike** — Four-inch tires built for the hard-pack sand at the waterline. The only bike here you can actually ride on the beach. From $18/hour.
- **Electric Bike** — Pedal-assist up to 20 mph. Wynwood, Bayside, Downtown and back without breaking a sweat in the Miami sun. From $25/hour.
- **Electric Tandem** — A pedal-assist tandem for two. The strongest rider sets the pace and nobody gets dropped halfway across the causeway. From $45/hour.
- **Trikke** — The three-wheeled carving vehicle this shop was built around. You steer it by leaning, it is easier than a bike, and nothing turns more heads on Ocean Drive. From $35/hour.
- **Segway** — Self-balancing, ridiculously fun and easier than it looks. Free training before every ride — and we sell and service them too. From $49/guided tour.
- **Side-by-Side & Tandem** — Four wheels, two seats, side by side — plus classic tandems. Talk the whole way instead of shouting over your shoulder. From $22/hour.
- **Adult Tricycle** — Three wheels, big rear basket, zero balance required. The pick for beach picnics and easy cruising. From $18/hour.
- **Rollerblades** — Skate the Beachwalk like a local. Sizes for the whole family, pads and helmet included with every pair. From $12/hour.
- **Longboards** — Longboards for the Beachwalk and Lincoln Road. Pads and a helmet with every board, and a five-minute lesson if it is your first time. From $14/hour.
- **Kids Bikes & Baby Seats** — Kids bikes from 12 to 24 inches, baby seats, trailers and training wheels. Everybody rolls, nobody gets left behind at the hotel. From $10/hour.

## Guided tours (https://www.miamibeachbikesandtours.com/tours.html)
- **Ocean Drive Segway Tour** (1 hour, from $49) — The short one, and the one everybody starts with. Ocean Drive, Lummus Park and the beachfront on a Segway, training included. Stops: Ocean Drive, Lummus Park, 10th St Auditorium, Beachwalk.
- **Star Island Segway Tour** (1 hour, from $69) — Over the MacArthur Causeway on the protected path to the gates of Star Island — cruise-ship terminal on one side, mansions on the other. Stops: MacArthur Causeway, Star Island, Palm & Hibiscus Islands, Terminal Island.
- **South Beach Segway Tour** (2 hours, from $79) — The long version: Ocean Drive, Española Way, Lincoln Road, South Pointe Park and the pier, with stops long enough to actually take pictures. Stops: Ocean Drive, Española Way, Lincoln Road, South Pointe Park.
- **Miami Beach Art Deco Segway Tour** (2 hours, from $79) — Glide the Art Deco Historic District while your guide unpacks 1930s Miami Beach — neon, porthole windows, eyebrows and racing stripes. Stops: Art Deco Historic District, Colony Hotel, Española Way, Washington Avenue.
- **Miami Millionaire's Row Segway Tour** (2.5 hours, from $89) — North up Collins past the Faena District, the Fontainebleau and the oceanfront estates of Millionaire's Row. Our biggest Segway route. Stops: Faena District, Fontainebleau, Millionaire's Row, Indian Beach Park.
- **Panoramic Night Private Chariot Tour** (~2 hours, from $None) — Private, after-dark and lit up: the neon of Ocean Drive, the causeway lights and the Downtown skyline reflected across Biscayne Bay. Stops: Ocean Drive neon, MacArthur Causeway, Biscayne Bay, Downtown skyline.
- **South Beach Trikke Tour** (1–2 hours, from $None) — The tour you cannot book anywhere else: carving South Beach on a three-wheeled Trikke, steering by leaning. Five minutes of training and you are gone. Stops: Ocean Drive, Lummus Park, Española Way, South Pointe Park.
- **Art Deco Bike Tour** (~2 hours, from $None) — The Art Deco district at bicycle pace, with no minimum age and no training needed. The family version of our signature route. Stops: Art Deco Historic District, Ocean Drive, Lummus Park, Española Way.
- **South Beach Coastal Ride** (90 min, from $None) — A flat, guided run down the car-free Beachwalk to South Pointe Park and the pier, with the Atlantic on your left the whole way. Stops: Beachwalk, Lummus Park, South Pointe Park, South Pointe Pier.
- **Wynwood & Downtown E-Bike Tour** (~4 hours, from $None) — Cross the bay under power and ride the murals of Wynwood, then the Design District, Bayside and Brickell. Our longest ride on two wheels. Stops: Wynwood Walls, Design District, Bayside Marketplace, Brickell.
- **Sunset Venetian Islands Ride** (2 hours, from $None) — Out across the Venetian Causeway at golden hour to watch the Downtown skyline switch on across Biscayne Bay. Stops: Venetian Causeway, Belle Isle, Di Lido Island, Sunset Harbour.
- **Free Wynwood Bike Tour** (~2 hours, from $0) — A guided run through the murals of Wynwood at no charge when you rent from us. Small groups, fixed departures, first come first served. Stops: Wynwood Walls, NW 2nd Avenue, Design District, Mural alleys.
- **Free Coconut Grove Bike Tour** (~2 hours, from $0) — Miami's oldest neighbourhood — banyan trees, the bayfront marina and Vizcaya — guided and free when you rent with us. Stops: CocoWalk, Bayfront marina, Barnacle Historic Park, Vizcaya.
- **Private Group & Corporate Tour** (Custom, from $None) — Bachelorette parties, team offsites, family reunions and film crews. Pick the machines, the route and the hour and we build the tour around you. Stops: Your route, Your pace, Photo stops, Optional guide car.

## Adventures and day trips (https://www.miamibeachbikesandtours.com/adventures.html)
- **Everglades Airboat Adventure** (4.5 hours) — Out to the River of Grass for an airboat run through the sawgrass, a wildlife show and alligators at close range. Transport from South Beach included. From $69 per person. Includes: Hotel pickup, Airboat ride, Wildlife show, Alligator encounter.
- **Key West Day Trip** (Full day) — The whole Overseas Highway, Seven Mile Bridge included, with around six free hours on the island for Duval Street, Mallory Square and the Southernmost Point. Price on request — call +1-305-830-9440. Includes: Seven Mile Bridge, Duval Street, Mallory Square, Southernmost Point.
- **Miami City Tour** (~4 hours) — Half a day across the whole city: Little Havana, Wynwood, the Design District, Brickell, Coconut Grove and back over the bay. Price on request — call +1-305-830-9440. Includes: Little Havana, Wynwood Walls, Design District, Coconut Grove.
- **Big Bus Hop-On Hop-Off Tour** (Day pass) — Open-top double-decker with a day pass across Miami and Miami Beach. Hop off at Wynwood, Bayside or Little Havana and pick the next bus up when you are done. Price on request — call +1-305-830-9440. Includes: South Beach, Wynwood, Bayside, Little Havana.
- **Jet Ski Rental** (30–60 min) — Open throttle on Biscayne Bay with the Downtown skyline as the backdrop. No licence needed, full safety brief before you launch. Price on request — call +1-305-830-9440. Includes: Marina check-in, Safety brief, Biscayne Bay run, Skyline views.
- **South Beach Parasailing** (~1 hour) — Six hundred feet above the Atlantic with the whole Miami Beach coastline under your feet. Solo, tandem or triple flights, optional splash-down. Price on request — call +1-305-830-9440. Includes: Marina check-in, Boat ride, Flight, Optional splash-down.
- **Biscayne Bay Millionaire's Row Cruise** (~90 min) — The mansions of Star, Palm and Hibiscus Islands seen the way they were meant to be — from a boat, with the Downtown skyline behind them. Price on request — call +1-305-830-9440. Includes: Star Island, Palm & Hibiscus, Port of Miami, Downtown skyline.
- **Speedboat & Sandbar Tour** (~2 hours) — Fast run out of the marina, then anchor at the sandbar where locals spend their Sundays in waist-deep, bath-warm water. Price on request — call +1-305-830-9440. Includes: Marina, Government Cut, Sandbar swim stop, Skyline run.
- **Miami Helicopter Ride** (15–30 min) — Flight over South Beach, Star Island, the Port of Miami and the Downtown skyline. The fastest way to understand how this city is laid out. Price on request — call +1-305-830-9440. Includes: South Beach, Star Island, Port of Miami, Downtown skyline.

- **Segway Personal Transporters** — We are Miami's factory authorized Segway dealer. New units, full warranty, delivery across South Florida and a test ride before you buy — at the shop, on Ocean Drive. Price on request — call +1-305-830-9440. Options: Segway i2 SE, Segway x2 SE, Trade-in / used.
- **Trikke & Electric Trikke** — The three-wheeled carving vehicle we are named after, in pedal and electric versions. Try one on a tour first, then buy the one you liked. Price on request — call +1-305-830-9440. Options: Trikke carving vehicle, Electric Trikke.
- **Electric Bikes & Bicycles** — New electric bikes and bicycles, plus ex-rental cruisers serviced by our own mechanics and sold at a fraction of new. Price on request — call +1-305-830-9440. Options: New electric bike, New bicycle, Ex-rental cruiser.
- **Segway i2 Parts & Accessories** — The full Segway parts range: lower cargo frames, upper and lower reflective shields, integrated lighting, patroller bag, front bumper, comfort mats and the optional accessory bar. Price on request — call +1-305-830-9440. Options: Lower cargo frame, Reflective shields, Integrated lighting system, Patroller bag, Front bumper, Comfort mats, Accessory bar.
- **Repairs & Service** — Flats, brakes, gears, wheel truing, battery diagnostics and full tune-ups — for bikes, e-bikes, scooters and Segways. Ours or yours. Most walk-in repairs done the same day. Price on request — call +1-305-830-9440. Options: Flat repair, Brake / gear service, Full tune-up, Segway service, Battery diagnostics.

## Cycling routes from the shop (https://www.miamibeachbikesandtours.com/routes.html)
- **The Beachwalk Classic** (8 km · 5 mi, 45 min, Easy): Straight down the paved Beachwalk to South Pointe Park and back. Flat, car-free, shaded in stretches, and the single best first ride in South Beach.
- **Art Deco Neon Loop** (6 km · 3.7 mi, 40 min, Easy): Ocean Drive, Collins, Washington and Española Way. Ride it after 7 PM when the neon fires up and the whole district turns pink and turquoise.
- **Star Island & the Causeway** (16 km · 10 mi, 1 h 15, Moderate): Protected bike path along the MacArthur Causeway to Palm, Hibiscus and Star Island. Cruise-ship views on one side, mansions on the other.
- **Venetian Islands Sunset** (14 km · 8.7 mi, 1 h, Moderate): Low-traffic island hopping across the Venetian Causeway. The classic golden-hour route with the Downtown skyline straight ahead.
- **Wynwood Mural Run** (26 km · 16 mi, 2 h, E-bike): Our e-bike route across the bay into the street-art district, looping back through the Design District and Bayside. Take the battery.
- **North Beach & Boardwalk** (20 km · 12.4 mi, 1 h 30, Moderate): Head north along the boardwalk past Mid-Beach, the Faena District and the Fontainebleau all the way to the quiet end of the island.

## Frequently asked questions (https://www.miamibeachbikesandtours.com/faq.html)
**Q: Where can I rent a bike in South Beach?**
A: At our shop at 233 14th Street, Miami Beach, FL 33139 — one block from Ocean Drive and the Beachwalk. We are open every day from 9 AM to 8 PM. Walk-ins are welcome and we also deliver across South Beach.

**Q: How much does it cost to rent a bike in Miami Beach?**
A: Beach cruisers start at $12 for one hour and $28 for all day (9 AM to 8 PM). Fat tire beach bikes start at $18/hour, electric bikes at $25/hour, adult tricycles at $18/hour, tandems at $22/hour and rollerblades at $12/hour. Helmet, lock and bottled water are included with every rental.

**Q: What is the happy hour special?**
A: Rent between 1 PM and 4 PM and you get one extra hour free on any bike, trike or skate rental. It applies to walk-ins and reservations alike, every day of the week.

**Q: How much are the Segway tours?**
A: The Ocean Drive Segway Tour is $49 per person for one hour. The Star Island Segway Tour is $69, the South Beach and Art Deco Segway Tours are $79 each for two hours, and the Miami Millionaire's Row Segway Tour is $89 for 2.5 hours. All Segway tours include training and require a minimum of two riders.

**Q: What is a Trikke?**
A: A Trikke is a three-wheeled carving vehicle you steer by leaning your body from side to side — no pedals, no balancing act. It is the machine this shop is named after, it takes about five minutes to learn, and we rent it from $25 for 30 minutes.

**Q: Do I need to book in advance?**
A: For rentals, no — walk-ins are welcome all day, every day. Booking ahead is recommended in high season (December to April) and on weekends, and it is required for Segway tours, day trips, jet skis, parasailing and helicopter rides, which all run on fixed departure times.

**Q: Do you deliver bikes to my hotel?**
A: Yes. We deliver and pick up at hotels, Airbnbs and condos across South Beach and Mid-Beach. Delivery is free on rentals of 24 hours or more within South Beach; shorter rentals and other areas carry a flat delivery fee. Day trips and adventures include hotel pickup.

**Q: How long can I keep the bike?**
A: From one hour up to 60 days. Daily, weekly and monthly rates drop sharply the longer you ride — a week costs about the same as three single days.

**Q: What is included with a rental?**
A: Every rental includes a helmet, a lock, a bottle of water, a Miami Beach route map and roadside support by phone while you are out riding. Baskets and baby seats are $5 each.

**Q: How old do you have to be to ride a Segway or a Trikke?**
A: Riders must be at least 14 years old; riders under 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Every tour begins with a free training session, so no previous experience is needed, and Segway PT tours require no deposit at booking or in store.

**Q: What else do you book besides bikes and Segways?**
A: Everglades airboat adventures (4.5 hours, $69), Key West day trips, Miami city tours, Big Bus hop-on hop-off passes, jet ski rentals, South Beach parasailing, Biscayne Bay and sandbar boat tours, and helicopter rides over the city. All of them can be booked at the shop, online or by phone at +1-305-830-9440, and most include hotel pickup.

**Q: What guided tours do you run?**
A: Twelve of them. Five Segway tours with published prices — Ocean Drive $49, Star Island $69, South Beach $79, Art Deco $79 and Millionaire's Row $89 — plus a South Beach Trikke tour, an Art Deco bike tour, the South Beach Coastal Ride, a Wynwood and Downtown e-bike tour, a sunset ride across the Venetian Islands, a private night chariot tour and fully custom private and corporate tours.

**Q: Some tours do not show a price. Why?**
A: Those run on seasonal schedules or are priced per group, so the rate depends on the date, the group size and the operator. Call +1-305-830-9440 or book online and we will quote you on the spot — every one of them is bookable.

**Q: Do you sell Segways and Trikkes?**
A: Yes. We are Miami's factory authorized Segway dealer, so we sell new Segway personal transporters with full warranty, plus pedal and electric Trikkes, electric bikes, bicycles and the complete Segway i2 parts range — cargo frames, reflective shields, integrated lighting, patroller bags, bumpers, comfort mats and the accessory bar. Call +1-305-830-9440 for current models and pricing.

**Q: Can I try a Segway or Trikke before buying one?**
A: Yes, and we recommend it. Rent the exact model for an hour, take it down Ocean Drive, and if you buy it we put the rental toward the purchase.

**Q: Are the neighbourhood bike tours really free?**
A: Yes. The guided Wynwood and Coconut Grove bike tours are free when you rent from us. They run on fixed departures in small groups, first come first served, so ask at the counter or call ahead to reserve a spot.

**Q: Can I leave my luggage at the shop?**
A: Yes. We hold luggage at the shop while you ride — useful on your check-out day or between a cruise and a flight. There is also a restroom and free Wi-Fi.

**Q: Is Miami Beach safe for cycling?**
A: Yes. South Beach is flat, compact and covered by protected bike lanes plus the car-free Beachwalk that runs the length of the sand. Florida law requires helmets for riders under 16 and we provide one with every rental.

**Q: Do you repair bikes, e-bikes and scooters?**
A: Yes. Our shop handles flat tires, brakes, gears, batteries and full tune-ups for bikes, e-bikes and scooters, with most walk-in repairs finished the same day. We are also an authorized Segway dealer for sales, parts and service.

**Q: What is your cancellation policy?**
A: Cancellations 30 or more days before the reservation receive a full refund; 15 to 30 days receive 50%; 8 to 14 days receive 25%; and cancellations within 7 days of the reservation are non-refundable. All reservations are pre-paid in US dollars.
